mechanism: Explicit MissionFormation priorities and complete-formation fallback override MissionSystem quantity constraints

configuration.mission: BASIC-MISSION at hour 8, duration 2, two-aircraft total
configuration.inherited_quantity_rule: MissionSystem.NOS=MNOS=1 for each A and B

variants.ab-high: AB priority 1, AA priority 2, A2+B1 deployed
variants.aa-high: AA priority 1, AB priority 2, A2+B1 deployed
variants.b-missing: AB priority 1, AA priority 2, only A2 deployed

hypotheses_to_test: AB-high flies A+B when both complete formations are available
AA-high flies A+A despite inherited MissionSystem minimum B1
B-missing falls back from unavailable high-priority AB to complete lower-priority AA
All three runs launch a full two-aircraft formation at hour 8 and complete at hour 10
limits: One fixed mission and two complete formations only
No failure, aircraft becoming ready later, formation reconfiguration, or positive-duration preparation
ALOAA continuation-only, equal-priority rejection, multiple missions, GUI-specific behavior and cross-engine parity remain unverified
